Why should anyone go to work for a LE Agency or the BCSO anymore? Once you begin work, you are ridiculed by both the public and your superiors. Once a complaint is filed, Supervisors and admin both get a preconceived idea in their head about the validity of the complaint, and project their own rational on how to deal with the deputy. And most of the time if the supervisor doesn’t like you for whatever reason, it gets taken out on you either through disciplinary action or behind the scene secret biases placed against the person, simply because of who you are to them. It shouldn’t be that way. It should be fair and balanced across the board for everyone, despite the secret hatred for the officer. 

Let me name some names….

When did Sheriff Mack believe it would be appropriate and professional to air complaints from citizens concerning deputies, on Facebook for all to see? By doing so, it has skewed any opinion that citizens would have (rather correctly or incorrectly) concerning that particular deputy, especially by calling out that deputy by name. Then to have a local lawyer comment about the post, with a statement about the deputy potentially being discredited (rather right or wrong). The doors have been opened widely for biases and statements without due process or the benefit of a clear 20/20 vision. Look the post up, 7/26/24
